summary: Round 5 is screened, published and checked, MOSS only, as prompts5.json's later decision says. The pool is 99 MOSS files (90 new, 9 carried from round 4): 73 kept, 26 thrown out (23 cut off, 3 several events). 17 of the 18 planned slots are published as category events5 (first on the page); the valve family has 2 of 3 because none of its six new files survived and the third carried file is a round-4 hand skip. Two picks were hand-skipped after spectrogram review (thruster_bang_1 s12: second events and a 0.95 s run-up; shield_bright_2 s12: about 40 clicks, a second event at 1.507 s at -1.9 dB) and their places were taken and looked at. Page checks on port 5311: audition-check 48 passed, 0 failed, 0 page faults (28 faults in files, 22 of them in shield_bright_2 s11); audition-level: all one-channel, file>page -0.09 to +0.50 dB dry. Level misses, not repaired: shield_bright_2 s11 leaves the page about 4.0 dB under its family (true-peak ceiling, crest 35.0 dB); valve s12 is 0.50 dB high. shield_bright share above 60 Hz / raw crest: s15 88.9 % / 11.7 dB, s11 99.0 % / 35.0 dB, s14 44.6 % / 17.7 dB. Manifest 165 entries; the 148 old hashes and the 48 render/source files are unchanged; ratings.json unchanged. Nobody listened.

problems: Stable Audio: the generate step made 90 SA files against the owner's later MOSS-only decision; screen.py has no source filter, so assets/audio/gen/r5/sa3/gen.json was renamed to gen.json.not-screened to keep SA out of the pool (undo: mv assets/audio/gen/r5/sa3/gen.json.not-screened assets/audio/gen/r5/sa3/gen.json; then screening would change the MOSS picks). The brief's Stable Audio label, licence note and -3.10 dB rule had nothing to apply to.
The brief says sixteen picks; prompts5.json has 18 slots; 17 published (valve slot 3 empty, not filled from another source).

shield_bright_2 s11 (ev5_6_shield_bright_2_moss_p2s11): true-peak ceiling stopped the gain, own -28.22 LUFS against target -24.0, about 4.0 dB under the other two shield picks; raw crest 35.0 dB; 22 clicks listed as file faults by audition-check. Not skipped, as it is not a plain fault of the README.
Valve files leave the page +0.50 dB (s12) and +0.29 dB (s15) above target, dry; s12 is 0.1 dB outside the about 0.4 dB rule.
All six new valve files (seeds 21-26) were thrown out (4 cut off, 2 several events); the proven valve family rests on two unheard round-4 files.
The tools' README step 5 command now reproduces screen.json only with the sa3 gen.json still renamed.
notVerified: No sound was listened to; no statement on how anything sounds.
Hand-skip review was by waveform, spectrogram and 50 ms levels of the 17 listening copies plus the two replacements, not of every kept file.
Whether the 20 dB cut-off threshold is right for the steady fold sounds was not tested.
The decoder's pressing against full scale was measured by crest only.
Page checks ran only with the 17 round-5 ids and the two controls, no scenes; the other sounds were not played.
